detail.longDescription:
@uvok@woof.tech I was in the same situation and replaced my NextCloud instance with @OpenCloud@social.opencloud.eu and #radicale (as part of opencloud) a while back. And I'm much happier with it. A primary driver for me was the fact that it's a compiled single Go binary. Been running for about 6 months now, 0 issues and more speed!
#homelab #selfhosted #selfhosting #opencloud
